About Us + Contact Us are Elementor (Flow B, not part of the 9-page HTML extraction, no layouts planned here). prefix.conflict_note: spec/site-spec.json meta.prefix suggests 'mizuho' (brand-derived, flagged there for confirmation). This plan uses 'm11' instead because CLAUDE.md (checked-in project standard, takes precedence) already fixes ACF Local JSON keys as group_m11_* / field_m11* and the theme function prefix as m11_. Not an open question -- resolved in favour of the existing, already-approved house convention.

conventions.flexible_field: sections (ONE field, on pages using page_template == page-flexible.php)
conventions.layout_naming: layout name snake_case -> template part template-parts/flex-blocks/<kebab-case>.php + assets/scss/layouts/_<kebab-case>.scss
conventions.two_tab_convention: Every FC layout below begins with tab:'Section Settings' + clone:common_settings, then tab:'Section Content' + the layout's own fields, per the house standard. Not applied to the two CPT field groups (m11_product, m11_resource) since they are plain field groups, not FC layouts -- see 'cpt_field_group_deviation' open question.
conventions.richtext_mapping:
Spec fields typed 'richtext' split two ways per house convention: short accent/heading fragments carrying an embedded /
(e.g. hero headline, value-card lead) -> ACF type 'text', rendered through restricted wp_kses (em,span,strong,br); longer paragraph copy (body copy, quotes, bios, descriptions) -> ACF type 'textarea' with new_lines:'', rendered with nl2br(esc_html()). Called out per-field only where the mapping is non-obvious.
conventions.no_default_value: No ACF field in this plan carries default_value, per CLAUDE.md. Placeholder/typo content found in the spec (attribution names, 'FPO IMAGE', the 'Sales HUb' typo) is recorded as sample seed content only, never as a default_value or invented correction.
conventions.anchors: Every FC layout below carries anchor_target:true in the spec and gets its optional anchor via common_settings.sec_id (house standard) -- no separate anchor field. instructions text on sec_id recommends the id needed to keep a real in-page link working (e.g. 'procedure-band' on Home's procedure_band layout) where the spec's anchors[] map shows a valid in-page target.
